create_Indexer: create an Indexer instance with a given vector size for flat or PQ indexing
index_data_Indexer: index a batch of document IDs and embeddings into the FAISS index
search_knn_Indexer: search the FAISS index for top-k nearest neighbors given query vectors
serialize_Indexer: serialize the FAISS index and its ID mapping to disk files
deserialize_from_Indexer: deserialize a FAISS index and its ID mapping from disk files
